title: No signature facts binding: "public fns returning Result" needs query-guess + read + string-match
wanted_capability: Signature introspection as a fact binding: code.signature(span) returning { name, visibility, return_type, params } from the AST, and/or code.functions(file, { public, returns }) semantic filtering. Tree-sitter structural queries can express visibility presence but not return-type identity, so the probe's core predicate ("public functions returning Result") was inexpressible in the v0 algebra. Empirically validates the analysis.fnSignature binding already sketched in the pressure-test v0 set (it was deferred out of slice 1).
fallback_used: Structural query for pub fns, then code.read each span and JavaScript string match for "-> Result" — correct on the fixture, fragile in general (collapses 3 cells into what should be 1 call).
resolution_note: code.signature(span) landed in commit 09c1863 (worktree branch refactor-v2-isolate): facts::fn_signature AST walk (Rust; other languages fail closed) returning name/visibility/is_async/params/return_type/generics, with the stale_span hash check BEFORE byte-range interpretation. Probe comparison on the identical recon task: probe-1 (no binding) 8 turns / 2 query failures; probe-3 (binding + recipe in declarations + visibility on code.items) 5 turns / 4 cells, composed items → Promise.all(signature) → read with zero query authoring and zero shell fallback. Probe-2 (binding present but idiom prose-buried) showed uptake needs steering — tracked under gap-47b8f954's doc half.
